description: Build the GO decision table and evidence matrix artifacts, and plot the live QuickGO annotation asymmetry against the computed dN/dS
code:
import requests
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",140)

# ---- live QuickGO refetch for the decision table + figure ----
def goann(acc):
    r=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search",
        headers={"Accept":"application/json"},
        params={"geneProductId":acc,"limit":200,"includeFields":"goName"},timeout=120)
    j=r.json()
    return pd.DataFrame([dict(go=a["goId"],name=a.get("goName",""),aspect=a["goAspect"],
        ev=a["goEvidence"],ref=a["reference"],src=a["assignedBy"]) for a in j["results"]])
gA=goann("UniProtKB:P83881"); gB=goann("UniProtKB:Q969Q0")
EXP={"EXP","IDA","IPI","IMP","IGI","IEP","HDA","HMP","HEP"}
summ=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(gene="RPL36A (P83881)",lines=len(gA),distinct_terms=gA.go.nunique(),
      experimental_lines=int(gA.ev.isin(EXP).sum()),exp_terms=gA[gA.ev.isin(EXP)].go.nunique()),
 dict(gene="RPL36AL (Q969Q0)",lines=len(gB),distinct_terms=gB.go.nunique(),
      experimental_lines=int(gB.ev.isin(EXP).sum()),exp_terms=gB[gB.ev.isin(EXP)].go.nunique())])
print(summ.to_string(index=False))

# ---- GO decision table ----
go_tab=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(gene="RPL36A",go_id="GO:0022625",term="cytosolic large ribosomal subunit",aspect="CC",
  current="IDA/HDA/IBA (PMID:12962325, 23636399, 25957688, 32669547)",
  lead="RETAIN term, QUALIFY evidence",
  reason="Term is certainly correct. All four sources are paralog-ambiguous: 12962325 is MALDI mass fingerprinting of HPLC-fractionated 60S proteins; 23636399/25957688/32669547 are cryo-EM models in which eL42 was assigned to P83881 by convention (163/163 human PDB entities map to P83881, 0 to Q969Q0)."),
 dict(gene="RPL36A",go_id="GO:0003735",term="structural constituent of ribosome",aspect="MF",
  current="IDA/IC/IBA/IEA/NAS",lead="RETAIN as core MF",
  reason="Core molecular function of eL42 regardless of which gene encodes it. Structural analysis here shows 60/105 residues contact rRNA or tRNA within 4 A in PDB 6EK0."),
 dict(gene="RPL36A",go_id="GO:0002181",term="cytoplasmic translation",aspect="BP",
  current="IDA/IC/IBA/NAS",lead="RETAIN as core BP",reason="Consistent with the CC and MF terms and with eL42 sitting at the E/P-site tRNA CCA interface."),
 dict(gene="RPL36A",go_id="GO:0003723",term="RNA binding",aspect="MF",
  current="HDA (PMID:22681889)",lead="RETAIN but treat as non-core and paralog-ambiguous",
  reason="From an mRNA interactome capture study identified by shared peptides. eL42 does bind nucleic acid, but as rRNA/tRNA within the ribosome, not as an mRNA-binding protein. GO:0003735 is the more informative MF."),
 dict(gene="RPL36A",go_id="GO:0005515",term="protein binding",aspect="MF",
  current="IPI (PMID:24965446, 32296183)",lead="Treat as non-core",
  reason="Uninformative for a ribosomal protein; GO:0003735 supersedes it."),
 dict(gene="RPL36A",go_id="GO:0005783",term="endoplasmic reticulum",aspect="CC",
  current="IDA (HPA, GO_REF:0000052)",lead="Treat as non-core, antibody-based",
  reason="Antibody staining cannot distinguish the paralogs, which differ by one residue; the signal is also expected for ER-bound ribosomes."),
 dict(gene="RPL36AL",go_id="GO:0022625",term="cytosolic large ribosomal subunit",aspect="CC",
  current="IBA only (GO_REF:0000033)",lead="ADD experimental-level annotation (IDA) from PMID:19647033",
  reason="Crosslinking of periodate-oxidised tRNA on human 80S ribosomes labelled RPL36AL, identified by MS. Also supported by 3,139 PeptideAtlas observations of the paralog-unique peptide DSLYAQGR."),
 dict(gene="RPL36AL",go_id="GO:0003735",term="structural constituent of ribosome",aspect="MF",
  current="IBA/IEA only",lead="STRENGTHEN",
  reason="dN/dS = 0.0055 (p = 3.3e-23) against the RPL36A CDS shows the protein sequence is held identical by selection; PMID:19647033 places the protein in native 80S ribosomes."),
 dict(gene="RPL36AL",go_id="GO:0005634",term="nucleus",aspect="CC",
  current="IDA (PMID:25468996, BHF-UCL)",lead="QUESTION / likely non-core",
  reason="Source is an E-cadherin interactome proteomics study. Peptide-level assignment to Q969Q0 rather than P83881 needs checking, and nuclear detection of a ribosomal protein is expected during assembly rather than being a distinct function."),
])
go_tab.to_csv("GO_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print("\nGO decision table rows:",len(go_tab))

# ---- evidence matrix ----
ev=pd.DataFrame([

  claim="RPL36AL protein is present in native human 80S ribosomes at the tRNA CCA site",

  context="human cell lines, cryo-EM",
  confidence="High for eL42 presence, zero for paralog identity. All 163 human PDB polymer entities matching either accession are labelled P83881"),
 dict(citation="this work (UniProt P83881, Q969Q0)",evidence_type="computational (alignment)",stance="supports",
  claim="The paralogs differ at a single residue",
  finding="105/106 identities (99.06%), no gaps, single difference K38 (RPL36A) vs R38 (RPL36AL)",
  context="UniProtKB canonical sequences",
  confidence="High; direct result"),

  claim="The differing residue is not buried and is not in a protein-protein interface",
  finding="Residue 38 RSA 0.315 isolated, 0.196 in the 80S; two heavy-atom contacts <=4 A, both to C74 of the E-site tRNA (chain S6); zero protein contacts; chain mean RSA 0.264 with 60/105 residues contacting nucleic acid",
  context="human 80S ribosome, 2.9 A cryo-EM",
  confidence="High as a computation on the deposited model; conditional on the deposited model being correct at this residue"),
 dict(citation="this work (Ensembl ENST00000553110, ENST00000298289)",evidence_type="evolutionary",stance="supports",
  claim="The paralogs are functionally interchangeable",
  finding="CDS 90.0% identical with 30 synonymous and 1 non-synonymous difference; dS 0.723, dN 0.0040, dN/dS 0.0055; Fisher OR 0.0046, p = 3.3e-23",
  context="human genome",
  confidence="High. Pairwise dN/dS on one gene pair, so the estimate is coarse, but the direction is unambiguous"),
 dict(citation="this work (UniProtKB, 42,560 reviewed human entries)",evidence_type="computational (digestion)",stance="supports",
  claim="A quantitative proteomics reporter peptide exists",
  finding="Trypsin gives DSLYAQGK (880.4290 Da) vs DSLYAQGR (908.4352 Da), 8-mers, zero missed cleavages, identical flanks, delta 28.0063 Da; each unique in the reviewed human proteome",
  context="in silico",
  confidence="High. Caveat: DSLYAQGK also occurs in the RPL36A-HNRNPH2 readthrough fragments H0Y3V9 and H7BZ11"),
 dict(citation="this work (EBI Proteins API; PeptideAtlas, ProteomicsDB)",evidence_type="database",stance="supports",
  claim="Public MS data already contain the discriminating peptides",
  finding="DSLYAQGK observed 4,756 times, DSLYAQGR 3,139 times; 100% sequence coverage of both proteins; 7 and 11 observed peptides respectively span residue 38",
  context="aggregated public human MS datasets",
  confidence="High for detection, low for stoichiometry: observation counts reflect dataset composition, not ribosome occupancy"),
 dict(citation="this work (GTEx v8 API)",evidence_type="expression",stance="qualifies",
  claim="One paralog dominates in human tissues",
  finding="Both genes >28 TPM in all 54 tissues; median log2(RPL36A/RPL36AL) -0.28; range -2.78 (whole blood) to +0.97 (sun-exposed skin)",
  context="GTEx v8 bulk RNA-seq, 54 tissues",
  confidence="High for mRNA. mRNA ratio does not equal incorporation ratio, since surplus ribosomal proteins are degraded"),
 dict(citation="this work (RCSB search API)",evidence_type="database",stance="competing",
  claim="Structures demonstrate RPL36A in the ribosome",
  finding="163/163 human polymer entities matching P83881 or Q969Q0 are annotated P83881; none Q969Q0",
  context="PDB",
  confidence="High. This is a deposition convention, not an observation, and it propagates into IDA-coded GO annotations"),
 dict(citation="PMID:35613268",evidence_type="structural",stance="qualifies",
  claim="eL42 residues matter functionally",
  finding="A conserved amino acid change in eL42 explains cycloheximide resistance in Candida albicans, at the E-site drug pocket",
  context="C. albicans 80S, 2.3 A cryo-EM",
  confidence="Medium relevance. Shows the eL42 E-site surface is functionally loaded, but the resistance residue is not position 38"),
 dict(citation="PMID:20063902",evidence_type="direct assay (2D gel + MS)",stance="competing",
  claim="Mammalian ribosomes show paralog heterogeneity",
  finding="Rodent ribosome heterogeneity was far less than in plants and yeast; L10-like and L39-like were testis-restricted, L22-like 1 a minor component. eL42 paralogs were not reported as heterogeneous",
  context="rat and mouse liver, mammary gland, testis ribosomes",
  confidence="Medium. A negative observation at the sensitivity of 2D gels, not a targeted test of the eL42 pair"),

ev.to_csv("evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)
print("evidence matrix rows:",len(ev))

# ---- figure: GO asymmetry, computed live ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.2))
x=np.arange(2); w=0.35
ax[0].bar(x-w/2,summ.lines,w,color="#4a5568",label="all annotation lines")
ax[0].bar(x+w/2,summ.experimental_lines,w,color="#c53030",label="experimental evidence lines")
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(["RPL36A\nP83881","RPL36AL\nQ969Q0"])
ax[0].set_ylabel("QuickGO annotation lines"); ax[0].legend(frameon=False)
ax[0].set_title("GO annotation depth differs 6-fold between\ntwo proteins that differ by one residue")
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(summ.lines,summ.experimental_lines)):
    ax[0].text(i-w/2,a+0.6,str(a),ha="center",fontsize=9); ax[0].text(i+w/2,b+0.6,str(b),ha="center",fontsize=9)

ax[1].bar(["synonymous\n(dS)","non-synonymous\n(dN)"],[0.7226,0.0040],color=["#2f855a","#c53030"])
ax[1].set_ylabel("substitutions per site")
ax[1].set_title("Purifying selection holds the two proteins identical\ndN/dS = 0.0055, Fisher p = 3.3e-23")
ax[1].text(0,0.74,"0.723",ha="center",fontsize=10); ax[1].text(1,0.03,"0.004",ha="center",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
